<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 4"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Base Kinesis](/Feats.aspx?ID=4334) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=12" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 57

**Archetype** [Kineticist](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=206)

**Prerequisites**
[Kineticist Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=4333)

</column>

---

You gain the [Base Kinesis](/Actions.aspx?ID=2126) impulse. For the purposes of determining when the range and Bulk improvements of the action occur, your kineticist level is equal to half your level (for example, Base Kinesis for a 10th-level character with this feat would have a range of 45 feet and could affect 1 Bulk of their chosen element).
name: Base Kinesis
